newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MONDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MONDAY ROUNDUP - USDA.

text.p: OMAHA, Aug 12 (Reuter) Slaughter steers and heifers were
not well tested, but few sales steady, USDA said. Demand and
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs -
load 66.00; dressed basis 105.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select
and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs - couple loads 65.50; dressed
basis 105.00. Confirmed - 1,000 Last Week - None Last Year - 400 Week To Date - 6,100 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 2,500 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 700
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
